title: Beginner Guide to Earn Money on YouTube: Tips for Those Who Have No Time
description: How to make money on YouTube fast? Let’s say you do have an account and a number of subscribers already. Well, first of all, to start making money off of it, join the YouTube Partner Program. You’ll be working with YouTube directly and making a percentage of all ads showing within your video. But to join the partner program, you need to be at least 18 years old or have an adult to manage money on your behalf.   The program can also be unavailable in some countries, but don’t worry, if you’re watching this video on YouTube, chances are your country’s good. Then there are specific requirements for the channel itself. The partner program requires you to have at least 1,000 subscribers and more than 4,000 watch hours in the past year. And your channel needs to follow YouTube policies and be deemed “advertiser friendly.” So let's find out what it means, what are the benefits of live streaming, and which ways to make money on YouTube are the best.  #brightside  TIMESTAMPS: The YouTube Partner Program 0:01 YouTube policies 0:44 The benefits of live streaming 3:06 Less obvious ways to make money 3:46 Affiliate programs 4:54 What if nothing works for you 7:09  Music by Epidemic Sound  https://www.epidemicsound.com/  Subscribe to Bright Side : https://goo.gl/rQTJZz ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Our Social Media: Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/brightside/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/brightgram/ 5-Minute Crafts Youtube: https://www.goo.gl/8JVmuC  Stock materials (photos, footages and other): https://www.depositphotos.com https://www.shutterstock.com https://www.eastnews.ru  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- For more videos and articles visit: http://www.brightside.me/

asr.full_text: Alright, let's say you do have an account and a number of subscribers already. First of all, to start making money off of it, join the YouTube Partner Program. You'll be working with YouTube directly and making a percentage of all ads showing within your video. To join the Partner Program, you need to be at least 18 years old or have an adult to manage money on your behalf. The program can also be unavailable in some countries, but don't worry. If you're watching this video on YouTube, chances are your country's good. Then, there are specific requirements for the channel itself. The partner program requires you to have at least 1,000 subscribers. And more than 4,000 watch hours in the past year. Finally, your channel needs to follow YouTube policies and be deemed advertiser-friendly. That means no adult content, mention or portrayal of things that can be seen as mature audience topics. The tricky part is that YouTube policies change all the time. So, it's highly recommended to check the most up-to-date guidelines on the YouTube website. They might have changed while you were watching this video. Once you get accepted into the partner program,. You'll need to enable monetization on your video and start making money off every viewing. For a little bigger channel with a loyal fanbase, there's an option of channel memberships. Viewers can buy membership to get exclusive access to a variety of content. Basic perks include special badges and emojis that would make them stand out in the comments. More elaborate goodies can be exclusive videos for members, live streams, or chats. Only channels already in the YouTube Partnership Program can apply here, though,. So you must still qualify for that. And the number of subs required is a lot higher. At least 30,000 people should be following you already. If your channel is not eligible, or if you have a problem signing up,. There's always third-party websites, such as Patreon. The difference is that exclusive perks will not be delivered straight to YouTube feed,. But rather sent to the Patreon app and via email. Next option is selling merchandise. Think of all the inside jokes that have appeared on your channel throughout its existence. Or do you have a very memorable logo and design for your channel? Can it be put on a t-shirt, cup, sticker, or keychain? If so, what are you waiting for? There are hundreds of e-commerce websites to help you create your personalized merchandise. That every dedicated fan would love to buy. Not only will you make a large cut from the sales,. The rest goes to production and hosting of the website. But can have a wardrobe full of clothes with your own face. If you have more than 10,000 subs,. You can have your own merchandise shelf under every video. It'll showcase your best items to everyone watching. Before creating a merchandise line, though,. Check Google-approved merch websites so that your stuff isn't banned. And remember, you can't do that in videos made for kids. Livestreams are also a great way to make some money as a content maker. Have a steady schedule. A livestream once a month or a week can make you enough cash to cover for video expenses. Answer your viewers' questions, tell them about your plans, and show behind the scenes of your next project. YouTube live streams support Super Chat and Super Stickers. For a small donation, a person's message will be highlighted and shown on top of the chat for some time. Answer only highlighted messages or have a donation goal. That always stimulates viewers to donate. Or you could host live streams on subscription platforms like Patreon or Twitch. Now, let's talk about less obvious ways to make money. You can get paid by different brands for featuring their product in your videos. If you're a small channel, best start by asking for a free product in exchange for a video promotion. Most smaller channels first write emails directly to brands and propose partnerships. Think of what your channel's main topic is, what kind of image you're creating, and what products would be appropriate for you. Would be weird for a gaming channel to promote a new eyeshadow palette or a set of knives, yeah. But a beauty channel or a cooking tutorials one would look just fine with those. In this case, it's up to you to negotiate prices and terms. Some brands want you to say their product was sent to you and talk about it for 30 seconds,. While others would have you put their name in the title or make a whole video about their brand. Don't forget, you still have to disclose your promotion. Go to the Advanced Video Settings and check the box next to Video Contains Paid Promotion. This way, you'll avoid trouble with both YouTube itself and your audience. Besides direct adverts, there's affiliate programs. Simply register on specific websites and put links in your description. If people in the comments are asking where you've gotten that carpet or chair,. Post an affiliate link to that item on Amazon. Now, every time a person clicks on your link and buys that item, you get a small reward. Some brands will give you a discount code for your viewers. Every time they use it, you get rewarded. It's a win-win. Your viewers pay less for an item they want to buy, and you get money for bringing them to the website. YouTube requires that you disclose the use of affiliate links. Plus, the more transparent you are, the better. Viewers don't like to be lied to. Another option is selling a final credit spot for another upcoming channel. A lot of small channels are looking for promotions,. And if your channel has a lot of subscribers,. You can make money by showing a snippet of other creators' videos at the end. Finally, if you feel like a true entrepreneur,. You can start your own brand and use your channel as a promotion for your company. You can have a jumpstart when you already have a fan base ready to check that new product. Depending on your channel's main topic and genre, you can sell tutorials or online classes. A beauty or fashion-related channel can sell color presets for Instagram pictures. A cooking channel can make and sell classes on specific techniques. Or you can even sell techniques on how to shoot and edit videos like you. Just remember, if you're promoting brands in your videos, don't turn your channel into a shop window. Your viewers are here to see you and your content. And don't want to be bombarded with some third-party products and affiliate links. Better have just a couple of brands you're working with,. But build a long-lasting partnership than try to sell everything at the same time. And if you desperately need money to continue working on videos, just be honest. If your audience likes you and your videos, they will relate to your struggles. Don't lie and don't be greedy. But if you're really in a bad situation, people connect to sincerity and would love to help their favorite creator. If none of the above works for you, though, focus more on your channel and branding. Find your niche, something only you know everything about. Do you love very specific types of games? Or you know all the best hidden places for a tourist in your town? Those topics are more interesting than something you've seen a million times on YouTube. Don't forget to buy some good gear so your voice is loud and clear and the picture is crisp and vibrant. Take some acting and speech classes to present your thoughts clearer and sound the best version of yourself. Now that you're making great quality videos to attract an audience, you need to be very consistent with your uploads. Being seen in people's feeds makes them remember you and check every new video. There are lots of tools and apps available for you to create a perfect upload schedule. Don't look for easy ways to cut corners. No matter what it looks like to you as a viewer,. Being a YouTube creator is hard work that requires long, sleepless nights. And many hours of filming and editing. Buying subscribers or views will do almost nothing for your channel. Also, do your best to interact with the viewers,. Reply to comments, develop other social media pages,. And use the Community tab to post updates and get feedback. And finally, work with your channel's appearance. Bright thumbnails, great video names, and accurate descriptions. Will put your videos in the Recommended and Search results, attracting more audience. Good luck!
